game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch, the volcano watchtower: the forge smith must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch: the volcano watchtower
core_gameplay_loop: In Eruption Watch, repeat each round: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots. Each round, a new ore chunks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the slot_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 300 points of ore chunks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 300, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Rounding Range
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Eruption Watch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slot_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Eruption Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 300 within 45 seconds.
